items.t: Under Armour lifts FY27 outlook despite Q2 revenue drop
items.sum: Under Armour has raised its fiscal 2027 (FY27) operating income forecast despite reporting a 7% fall in second quarter (Q2) revenue and narrowing its expected gross-margin improvement.

items.t: Telsey Advisory Group Maintains Market Perform on Under Armour, Lowers Price Target to $5
items.sum: Telsey Advisory Group analyst Cristina Fernandez maintains Under Armour (NYSE:UAA) with a Market Perform and lowers the price target from $5.5 to $5.

items.t: Under Armour's Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Cost Discipline
items.sum: UAA beats Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings estimates despite declining sales, traffic weakness and margin pressures, while maintaining its annual earnings outlook.

items.t: What Under Armour (UA) Said on Its Q2 Earnings Call
items.sum: Under Armour (NYSE:UA) reported a 7% decline in fiscal second-quarter revenue and lowered its full-year gross margin outlook, as weaker store traffic, inventory markdowns and higher freight costs weighed on the athletic apparel company. items.t: Under Armour Stock Has The Bull Case Changed After Lowered Guidance
items.sum: Under Armour updated its fiscal 2027 outlook after reporting a 7% quarterly revenue decline, citing added external cost pressures, planned inventory actions, and higher headwinds tied to the Middle East conflict, along with a near breakeven earnings range.
